title: Query-Guided Visual Minimization for Selective Disclosure to Cloud VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.32302v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cloud-hosted vision-language models (VLMs) require sending images beyond the user's local trust boundary, potentially exposing sensitive information the query does not need. We study query-guided visual minimization: a trusted local transformation preserves query-relevant visual content and reduces unnecessary disclosure before transmission. Unlike query-agnostic anonymization, it preserves the same sensitive content when the query requires it and suppresses it otherwise. We introduce QGVM, a framework that combines query grounding with an independent sensitive-item inventory, determines disclosure necessity at the type, instance, and text-content levels, and renders a minimized image for a black-box downstream VLM. We evaluate QGVM on complementary benchmarks measuring task utility, directly recoverable sensitive information, and inferential geolocation leakage. With OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, QGVM achieves 85.3% DoxBench answer correctness

translated_title: 面向云端视觉语言模型选择性披露的查询引导视觉最小化
translated_abstract: 云端托管的视觉语言模型（VLM）要求将图像发送到用户本地信任边界之外，这可能暴露查询并不需要的敏感信息。我们研究了查询引导的视觉最小化：一种可信的本地转换，在传输之前保留与查询相关的视觉内容并减少不必要的披露。与查询无关的匿名化方法不同，当查询需要时它保留相同的敏感内容，否则则抑制该内容。我们提出了QGVM框架，该框架将查询定位与独立的敏感项目清单相结合，在类型、实例和文本内容层面确定披露的必要性，并为黑盒下游VLM渲染最小化后的图像。我们在互补的基准上评估QGVM，衡量任务效用、可直接恢复的敏感信息以及推断性地理位置泄露。使用OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol，QGVM在DoxBench上实现了85.3%的答案正确率。
tldr: 提出QGVM框架，通过查询引导的本地视觉最小化处理，在将图像发送至云端VLM之前保留查询所需内容，同时抑制不必要的敏感信息泄露。
en_tdlr: QGVM is a query-guided visual minimization framework that preserves query-relevant content while suppressing unnecessary sensitive disclosures before sending images to cloud-hosted VLMs.
